paragraphs: I’m a Full Stack Developer currently working as a Backend Developer at Maticz Technologies Private Limited, where I build scalable backend services and enterprise applications using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.

I have hands-on experience building and delivering 7+ real-world applications across domains including HRMS, FinTech, Cryptocurrency trading, ride-booking, Web3, and blockchain/token launchpad platforms. My experience spans both frontend and backend development, with a strong foundation in the MERN Stack.

My core technical expertise includes React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, Redux, Socket.IO, and Web3. I have practical experience in backend development, authentication and authorization, database design, API integration, real-time communication, and business logic implementation.

I enjoy solving complex technical problems, debugging applications across the frontend and backend, and building scalable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions. I also work with MongoDB/Mongoose, Redis, Git, Postman, PM2, and Linux, and continuously strengthen my skills by working with modern technologies and AI-assisted development tools.

I hold a B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering from Sethu Institute of Technology, with a CGPA of 9.133. I’m passionate about continuous learning, hands-on development, and creating reliable software solutions that solve real-world problems.
